ResourceHeader.Description: Operational Level 3 image data from the Compact Coronagraph-1 (CCOR-1) aboard the GOES-19 spacecraft. The data consist of background-subtracted white-light coronagraph images of the solar corona generated from Operational Level 2 data and downsampled by a factor of two. The images have dimensions of 1024 by 960 pixels and are provided in FITS format in units of mean solar brightness (MSB). The nominal data cadence is approximately 15 minutes.

Parameter.Name: FITS Extension #1 Background-Subtracted Downsampled White-Light Coronal Intensity Data Array
Parameter.Description: CCOR-1 Operational Level 3 background-subtracted white-light coronal intensity stored in FITS extension #1 as a 1024 x 960 pixel compressed floating-point image array. The Level 3 image is generated by downsampling the Level 2 image by a factor of two. The image is expressed in mean solar brightness (MSB) and uses helioprojective solar coordinates with a zenithal polynomial (ZPN) projection. The plate scale is approximately 38.66 arcsec per pixel at the reference point. The CCOR-1 bandpass is approximately 480 to 730 nm. The reference observation time is specified by the DATE-OBS FITS keyword.
